item.title: Sumo Tigers may not be ratified, but that won’t stop them from practicing
item.description: In Vancouver, Mansfield ran the Sumo Tigers club, which he brought with him to Victoria. Though Mansfield did not know enough students to meet the membership requirements for the UVSS to ratify his club, Sumo Tigers still meets for free outdoor practices at Willows Beach every Saturday. Sumo Tigers will soon be moving indoors to Hood Rich Jiu Jitsu. The post Sumo Tigers may not be ratified, but that won’t stop them from practicing appeared first on Martlet.
